steps.label: up
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && : > upthumb.res; while read f t u; do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT -H "Content-Type: $t" -H 'If-None-Match: *' -T "$f" "$u"); echo "$f $c" >> upthumb.res; done < up/up_thumb.txt; echo fertig >> upthumb.res; cat upthumb.res
